name: olai
//dependencies: Runtime dependencies of the hydrated @kolu/* sources are declared HERE, at the root, and not only in the workspace member that imports them: the isolated linker (bunfig.toml) symlinks the root package's direct dependencies into the root node_modules, which is where node_modules/@kolu/<name>/src/*.ts resolves its own imports by walking up. A hydrated source importing something absent from this list is the failure that invariant exists to prevent.
//overrides: One effect instance, always. `effect` is pinned to the EXACT version the npins-pinned kolu declares (npins/sources.json → kolu → packages/surface/package.json), and pinned here so a transitive bump cannot smuggle in a second copy: Effect's error narrowing is `_tag`-structural precisely because two module instances would otherwise stop recognising each other's classes — and `instanceof`, Context keys and Schema identity do not even have that fallback. Re-pinning kolu means re-reading its version and moving this line with it.
